why.zh: 白名单外的本地账户，常见于入侵后留后门。
why.en: Local accounts outside the allowlist usually mean a planted backdoor.

fix.zh: 先确认来源，无主则禁用：Disable-LocalUser。
fix.en: Confirm the owner first; disable if unclaimed.

why.zh: 无密码匿名入口，默认应禁用。
why.en: Anonymous entry point; should stay disabled.

fix.zh: net user Guest /active:no
fix.en: net user Guest /active:no

title.zh: 管理员组成员超出预期

why.zh: 提权第一步通常是加管理员，成员越多面越大。
why.en: Privilege escalation starts by joining this group.

fix.zh: 核对每个管理员账户的来历，移除无主的。
fix.en: Verify each admin, remove the unowned ones.

why.zh: 关掉 UAC 等于给所有提权动作免签。
why.en: UAC off lets every elevation pass silently.

fix.zh: EnableLUA 恢复为 1，ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin 恢复为 5。
fix.en: Restore EnableLUA=1 and ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=5.

why.zh: 最短长度小于 8 或锁定阈值为 0 时，爆破成本极低。
why.en: Min length under 8 or lockout at 0 makes brute force cheap.

fix.zh: net accounts /minpwlen:8 /lockoutthreshold:5
fix.en: net accounts /minpwlen:8 /lockoutthreshold:5

title.zh: 自启动项指向不存在的文件
title.en: Autorun entry points to a missing file

why.zh: 卸载残留，无害但占位；也可能是有东西被删了没清干净。
why.en: Leftover from an uninstall, or debris after a cleanup.

fix.zh: 确认无用后删除对应注册表值。
fix.en: Delete the registry value once confirmed unused.

title.zh: 自启动项只有裸文件名
title.en: Autorun entry is a bare filename

why.zh: 没有绝对路径就会按 PATH 搜索，任何同名文件都能顶替。
why.en: No absolute path means PATH resolution; any same-named file can hijack it.

fix.zh: 删除该注册表值，或补上绝对路径。
fix.en: Delete the value, or pin it to an absolute path.

title.zh: 计划任务从用户可写目录运行
title.en: Scheduled task runs from a user-writable directory

why.zh: 任务以 SYSTEM 运行时，替换它指向的 exe 就直接拿到最高权限。
why.en: A SYSTEM task plus a replaceable binary equals free privilege escalation.

fix.zh: 把任务指向系统目录下的副本，或收紧目录 ACL。
fix.en: Point the task at a system path, or tighten the directory ACL.

title.zh: 非系统 WMI 永久订阅

why.zh: 无文件落地的持久化，事件触发即执行，常规杀软容易漏。
why.en: Fileless persistence triggered by events; commonly missed by AV.

fix.zh: 导出 consumer 内容确认来源，再删除 filter 与 binding。
fix.en: Dump the consumer, then remove filter and binding.

title.zh: Winlogon 的 Shell 或 Userinit 被改

why.zh: 登录即执行，改了就等于把后门焊在登录流程里。
why.en: Runs at logon; a change welds the backdoor into the login path.

fix.zh: Shell 恢复 explorer.exe，Userinit 恢复 userinit.exe。
fix.en: Restore Shell=explorer.exe and Userinit=userinit.exe.

why.zh: 给程序挂 Debugger，等于每次启动都先跑别的代码。
why.en: A Debugger entry runs foreign code before the real binary.

fix.zh: 删除对应子键的 Debugger 值。
fix.en: Remove the Debugger value under the affected subkey.

why.zh: 每个加载 user32 的进程都会带它，是老牌注入位。
why.en: Every user32-loading process pulls it in; classic injection slot.

fix.zh: 清空 AppInit_DLLs 并确认 LoadAppInit_DLLs=0。
fix.en: Clear AppInit_DLLs and set LoadAppInit_DLLs=0.

title.zh: 启动文件夹存在可执行文件

why.zh: 位置好找、容易被塞东西。
why.en: Easy to find, easy to drop something into.

fix.zh: 核对来源，非本人放置的移走。
fix.en: Verify origin; move out anything not placed by you.

title.zh: 服务指向不存在的文件
title.en: Service points to a missing binary

why.zh: 卸载残留，白占服务表。
why.en: Uninstall debris occupying the service table.

fix.zh: sc delete 服务名。
fix.en: sc delete <name>

title.zh: 服务二进制在用户可写目录
title.en: Service binary sits in a user-writable path

why.zh: 能写这个目录的人就能用服务权限执行任意代码。
why.en: Whoever can write there executes code as the service account.

fix.zh: 迁到 Program Files 下，或收紧 ACL。
fix.en: Relocate under Program Files, or tighten the ACL.

title.zh: 非微软进程注册成 svchost 组服务
title.en: Non-Microsoft process registered as a svchost group service

why.zh: 挤进 svchost 是为了混在系统进程里不被注意。
why.en: Hiding inside svchost is camouflage by design.

fix.zh: 确认厂商后决定保留；无主则删除该服务。
fix.en: Keep only if the vendor is known; otherwise delete.

title.zh: 加载了未签名内核驱动

why.zh: 驱动层可以绕过所有用户态检查。
why.en: Kernel layer bypasses every user-mode check.

fix.zh: 核对文件路径与厂商，来源不明则停用并隔离文件。
fix.en: Verify path and vendor; disable and quarantine if unknown.

title.zh: 服务 ImagePath 含相对路径或未加引号
title.en: Service ImagePath is relative or unquoted

why.zh: 未加引号的带空格路径可以被同名目录里的程序抢先执行。
why.en: An unquoted path with spaces can be hijacked by a lookalike binary.

fix.zh: 给 ImagePath 补上引号与绝对路径。
fix.en: Quote it and make it absolute.

why.zh: 远程桌面是全内网可达的高价值入口。
why.en: Remote desktop is a high-value entry reachable from the whole LAN.

fix.zh: 关闭 RDP，或改绑回环 + 防火墙限定来源。
fix.en: Disable RDP, or bind to loopback and restrict sources.

why.zh: 永恒之蓝这一代漏洞全靠它。
why.en: The EternalBlue family all leans on it.

fix.zh: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature SMB1Protocol。
fix.en: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature SMB1Protocol.

why.zh: 2049 与 111 一起对外，多数 Windows 主机根本用不到。
why.en: Exposes 2049 and 111 for a feature most hosts never use.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 NfsService 与 NfsClnt。
fix.en: Stop and disable NfsService and NfsClnt.

why.zh: 多为第三方服务把监听绑到了 0.0.0.0。
why.en: Usually a third-party service binding to 0.0.0.0.

fix.zh: 确认软件后改绑 127.0.0.1。
fix.en: Rebind to 127.0.0.1 once the software is identified.

why.zh: 关一个档就等于少一道网。
why.en: One profile off means one layer gone.

fix.zh: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Enabled True。
fix.en: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Enabled True.

why.zh: 自制工具也走这条路，但需要逐个确认来源。
why.en: Homegrown tools also land here; verify each one.

fix.zh: 核对路径与厂商，非本人软件则停掉并隔离。
fix.en: Check path and vendor; stop and quarantine unknown ones.

title.zh: 进程从 Temp / AppData / 桌面运行
title.en: Process runs from Temp, AppData or Desktop

why.zh: 正规程序装到系统目录，从可写目录起的是另一回事。
why.en: Real installers live in system paths; writable paths mean something else.

fix.zh: 确认来源，可疑则结束进程并保留样本。
fix.en: Verify origin; kill and preserve the sample if suspicious.

why.zh: 运行中却查不到文件，多为文件自删除型行为。
why.en: Still running but the file is gone: typical self-delete behaviour.

fix.zh: 记录 PID 与父进程，先 dump 再结束。
fix.en: Record PID and parent, dump then kill.

why.zh: 没有它，内存马和编码命令基本不留痕。
why.en: Without it, obfuscated commands leave no trace.

fix.zh: 开 ScriptBlockLogging 与 ModuleLogging。
fix.en: Enable ScriptBlockLogging and ModuleLogging.

why.zh: 4625 不记录，爆破就没声音。
why.en: No 4625 means brute force is silent.

fix.zh: auditpol 打开 Logon 的 failure。
fix.en: auditpol enable Logon failure.

why.zh: 可被投毒劫持认证，内网渗透常用。
why.en: Poisonable to relay credentials; a LAN staple.

fix.zh: 组策略关闭 EnableMulticast。
fix.en: Disable EnableMulticast via policy.

title.zh: SMB 服务端签名未强制

why.zh: 同网段可以不碰密码直接中继认证，内网最常见的一条。
why.en: Relay credentials on the same segment without touching a password; the most common LAN finding.

fix.zh: RequireSecuritySignature 设为 1。
fix.en: Set RequireSecuritySignature to 1.

title.zh: SMB 客户端签名未强制

why.zh: 不强制签名，等于接受对方降级到无签名会话。
why.en: Without it the client accepts a peer that downgrades the session.

fix.zh: LanmanWorkstation 下 RequireSecuritySignature 设为 1。
fix.en: Set RequireSecuritySignature under LanmanWorkstation to 1.

why.zh: 共享内容在网络上是明文，抓包就能读到。
why.en: Share contents travel in clear text and are readable from a capture.

fix.zh: EncryptData 设为 1，仅 SMB3 客户端可连。
fix.en: Set EncryptData to 1; only SMB3 clients can connect afterwards.

why.zh: 允许 NTLMv1 或更早的认证，哈希可被直接爆破。
why.en: Permits NTLMv1 or older, whose hashes fall to offline cracking.

fix.zh: LmCompatibilityLevel 设为 5。
fix.en: Set LmCompatibilityLevel to 5.

why.zh: 无需凭据就能列出账户、共享和策略，侦察的起点。
why.en: Accounts, shares and policy listable without credentials; the start of recon.

fix.zh: RestrictAnonymous 设为 1。
fix.en: Set RestrictAnonymous to 1.

title.zh: NTLM 会话安全低于完整性加加密
title.en: NTLM session security below integrity and encryption

why.zh: 缺少完整性或加密位，中间人可以改包或用降级攻击。
why.en: Missing the integrity or encryption bit lets a relay alter or downgrade traffic.

fix.zh: NTLMMinClientSec 与 NTLMMinServerSec 均设为 537395200。
fix.en: Set both NTLMMinClientSec and NTLMMinServerSec to 537395200.

why.zh: 没有 PPL，任何管理员权限的进程都能打开 lsass 读凭据。
why.en: Without PPL any admin-level process can open lsass and read credentials.

fix.zh: RunAsPPL 设为 2 后重启。
fix.en: Set RunAsPPL to 2 and reboot.

title.zh: RDP 加密级别低于 High

why.zh: 低级别允许协商到弱加密，远程会话可被解开。
why.en: Lower levels negotiate weak ciphers that can be unwrapped.

fix.zh: MinEncryptionLevel 设为 3。
fix.en: Set MinEncryptionLevel to 3.

title.zh: RDP 剪贴板与磁盘重定向开放
title.en: RDP clipboard and drive redirection open

why.zh: 远程会话能直接读本地磁盘，数据外带不需要别的通道。
why.en: A remote session reads the local disk directly, so exfiltration needs no other channel.

fix.zh: fDisableClip 与 fDisableCdm 均设为 1。
fix.en: Set both fDisableClip and fDisableCdm to 1.

why.zh: 插入介质自动执行，U 盘是最省事的入口。
why.en: Inserting media runs code; a USB stick is the cheapest way in.

fix.zh: NoDriveTypeAutoRun 设为 255。
fix.en: Set NoDriveTypeAutoRun to 255.

title.en: UAC does not use the secure desktop

why.zh: 同意框画在普通桌面上，可被其他窗口遮挡或模拟点击。
why.en: The consent prompt draws on the normal desktop, where it can be covered or clicked through.

fix.zh: PromptOnSecureDesktop 设为 1。
fix.en: Set PromptOnSecureDesktop to 1.

why.zh: 脚本会话不留文本记录，事后只能靠命令历史猜。
why.en: Script sessions leave no text record, so post-hoc review relies on guessing.

fix.zh: EnableTranscripting 设为 1 并指定输出目录。
fix.en: Set EnableTranscripting to 1 and name an output directory.

why.zh: vbs 与 js 双扩展名文件直接执行，是钓鱼附件的常见载荷。
why.en: vbs and js run straight from a double-click; a staple phishing payload.

fix.zh: HKLM 下 Script Host Settings\Enabled 设为 0。
fix.en: Set Script Host Settings\Enabled to 0 under HKLM.

why.zh: 塞满日志就能挤掉入侵痕迹，攻击者常用的一招。
why.en: Flooding the log pushes evidence out; a standard cleanup trick.

fix.zh: Retention 设为 1，写满后保留不覆盖。
fix.en: Set Retention to 1 so a full log stops rather than overwrites.

why.zh: 容量小则保留窗口短，翻旧账时已经没了。
why.en: A small cap means a short window; by the time you look, it is gone.

fix.zh: MaxSize 至少 20 MB，建议 100 MB。
fix.en: Raise MaxSize to at least 20 MB, 100 MB preferred.

why.zh: 无需认证即可列出本地账户名，为爆破做准备。
why.en: Local account names listable without authentication, which feeds a brute force.

fix.zh: RestrictAnonymousSAM 设为 1。
fix.en: Set RestrictAnonymousSAM to 1.

why.zh: 匿名身份被并入 Everyone，共享和注册表权限会连带开放。
why.en: Anonymous identities join Everyone, which opens shares and registry rights with it.

fix.zh: EveryoneIncludesAnonymous 设为 0。
fix.en: Set EveryoneIncludesAnonymous to 0.

why.zh: 开启后 lsass 内存里留着明文密码，被 dump 就等于交账号。
why.en: On, plaintext passwords sit in lsass memory; one dump and the accounts are gone.

fix.zh: UseLogonCredential 设为 0 或删除该值后重启。
fix.en: Set UseLogonCredential to 0 or delete the value, then reboot.

why.zh: 任何用户装 MSI 都以 SYSTEM 运行，等于本地提权后门。
why.en: Any user's MSI runs as SYSTEM, which is a local privilege escalation backdoor.

fix.zh: 机器与用户两个位置的该值都删除。
fix.en: Delete the value in both the machine and user hives.

why.zh: 异常链缺少校验，利用栈溢出时少一道阻碍。
why.en: Without chain validation a stack overflow exploit has one less hurdle.

fix.zh: 删除 DisableExceptionChainValidation 或设为 0。
fix.en: Delete DisableExceptionChainValidation or set it to 0.

why.zh: 先搜当前目录，把恶意 DLL 放旁边就能被加载。
why.en: Searching the working directory first lets a DLL dropped next to an exe load.

fix.zh: SafeDllSearchMode 设为 1 或删除该值。
fix.en: Set SafeDllSearchMode to 1 or delete the value.

title.zh: 账户登录审计未开成功
title.en: Account logon success auditing is off

why.zh: 跨机认证不留记录，横向移动的痕迹全在别处。
why.en: Cross-host authentication leaves nothing here, so lateral movement hides elsewhere.

fix.zh: auditpol 开启 Account Logon 的成功审计。
fix.en: Enable success auditing for Account Logon with auditpol.

why.zh: 没有 4688，就无法还原攻击者执行过什么命令。
why.en: Without 4688 there is no record of what the attacker actually ran.

fix.zh: 开启 Detailed Tracking 下的进程创建成功审计。
fix.en: Enable process creation success auditing under Detailed Tracking.

title.en: Audit policy changes are not recorded

why.zh: 有人改审计规则本身也该留痕，否则等于可以关灯。
why.en: Editing the audit rules should itself leave a mark, or the lights can simply be switched off.

fix.zh: 开启 Policy Change 的成功审计。
fix.en: Enable success auditing under Policy Change.

title.zh: 临时目录有近期可执行文件
title.en: Recent executable in a temp directory

why.zh: 落地即执行是最常见的投递方式。
why.en: Drop-and-run is the most common delivery.

fix.zh: 取哈希核实来源，未确认前不要删除。
fix.en: Hash it, verify origin, do not delete before confirming.

why.zh: 绿色版软件常驻桌面，也方便别人投递。
why.en: Portable apps live here, and so do deliveries.

fix.zh: 逐个确认是不是自己放的。
fix.en: Confirm each one is yours.

why.zh: 密码落在文本里，等于把钥匙放门口。
why.en: Passwords in plain text put the key at the door.

fix.zh: 迁移进凭据管理器，清掉原文件。
fix.en: Move into Credential Manager, delete the file.

why.zh: 1102 事件出现，几乎等于有人擦过现场。
why.en: An 1102 almost always means someone wiped the scene.

fix.zh: 立即留存剩余日志并排查清除时间点前后动作。
fix.en: Preserve remaining logs, review actions around that timestamp.

why.zh: 4624 类型 3/10 出现在非预期来源。
why.en: Type 3 or 10 logons from unexpected sources.

fix.zh: 核对源 IP 与账户，必要时改密。
fix.en: Verify source and account; rotate credentials if needed.

title.zh: 已安装程序缺少签名信息

why.zh: 发布者为空的条目多半来路不正。
why.en: Blank publisher usually means uncertain provenance.

fix.zh: 核对安装来源，必要时卸载。
fix.en: Verify the install source, uninstall if unknown.

title.zh: 驱动从系统目录之外加载
title.en: Driver loads from outside the system directory

why.zh: 签名有效的第三方驱动常见于虚拟化和杀软，但也可能被放进 ProgramData 躲检查。
why.en: A signed third-party driver is normal for virtualisation and AV, but one parked in ProgramData is hiding.

fix.zh: 核对签名主体和厂商，不认识的停用对应服务。
fix.en: Check the signer and vendor; disable the service if unknown.

title.zh: 驱动登记的文件不存在
title.en: Driver points at a missing file

why.zh: 残留的服务登记，本身无害，但会让排查清单变脏。
why.en: A leftover service registration; harmless, but it pollutes the list.

fix.zh: 确认无用后 sc delete 删除对应服务。
fix.en: Delete the service once confirmed unused.

why.zh: 内核态没有用户态那些缓解措施，一个无效签名的驱动等于整机失守。
why.en: Kernel mode has none of the user-mode mitigations; an invalid signature is game over.

fix.zh: 立即停用该驱动并保留文件做取证分析。
fix.en: Disable the driver now and preserve the file for analysis.

title.zh: 易受攻击驱动阻止列表未启用

why.zh: BYOVD 攻击专门找这类旧驱动，阻止列表是最省事的一道闸。
why.en: BYOVD attacks hunt exactly these old drivers; the blocklist is the cheapest gate.

fix.zh: VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable 设为 1。
fix.en: Set VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable to 1.

why.zh: 这个开关原本给驱动开发者用，留着等于给自签驱动开门。
why.en: Meant for driver developers; left on, it lets self-signed drivers through.

fix.zh: bcdedit /set testsigning off 后重启。
fix.en: bcdedit /set testsigning off, then reboot.

why.zh: 调试通道能让本地内核内存被读写，正常使用不该开。
why.en: The debug channel allows reading and writing kernel memory; normal use never needs it.

fix.zh: bcdedit /debug off 后重启。
fix.en: bcdedit /debug off, then reboot.

why.zh: 虚拟化层做代码完整性校验，脏的内核页写不进去。
why.en: Code integrity enforced in the virtualisation layer, so dirty kernel pages cannot be written.

fix.zh: HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity\Enabled 设为 1，重启生效。
fix.en: Set HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity\Enabled to 1 and reboot.

title.zh: 与基线相比出现新增持久化项

why.zh: 基线之后新增的东西，才是真正要看的差异。
why.en: The delta after the baseline is what actually matters.

fix.zh: 逐条确认新增项是否是本人安装造成。
fix.en: Confirm each new item came from your own install.

title.zh: 打印机处理器加载第三方 DLL
title.en: Print processor loads a third-party DLL

why.zh: spoolsv 在登录时加载这里的 DLL，是已知的持久化加载点。
why.en: spoolsv loads this DLL at logon; a known persistence loader.

fix.zh: 确认来源，非必要则删除对应的 Print Processors 子键。
fix.en: Confirm the source; delete the Print Processors subkey if unneeded.

why.zh: 每创建一个进程都加载这里的 DLL，影响范围覆盖所有程序。
why.en: Loaded on every process creation, so it affects everything.

fix.zh: 清空该键下所有值。
fix.en: Clear every value under this key.

title.zh: 服务失败时执行外部程序
title.en: Service runs an external program on failure

why.zh: FailureActions 可以指定崩溃后运行的程序，被用来做触发式持久化。
why.en: FailureActions can launch a program on crash; used for trigger-based persistence.

fix.zh: 检查指向的程序，非运维需要则清除该配置。
fix.en: Check what it points at, clear it unless ops genuinely need it.

title.zh: 计划任务使用 COM 处理器
title.en: Scheduled task uses a COM handler

why.zh: COM handler 不显示命令行，常规排查最容易整片漏过。
why.en: COM handlers expose no command line, which is why they get missed.

fix.zh: 确认任务来源，删除非自建任务。
fix.en: Confirm the source, remove tasks you did not create.

why.zh: 登录时由 winlogon 加载，劫持后直接拿到登录上下文。
why.en: Loaded by winlogon at logon; hijacking it hands over the logon context.

fix.zh: 非系统组件一律删除对应子键。
fix.en: Delete the subkey unless it is a known system component.

title.zh: Active Setup 指向可写目录
title.en: Active Setup points at a writable path

why.zh: 用户首次登录会执行 StubPath，新建账户时也会跟着跑一遍。
why.en: StubPath runs on every user's first logon, including accounts created later.

fix.zh: 核对 StubPath 来源，删除非微软条目。
fix.en: Check the StubPath source; remove non-Microsoft entries.

why.zh: explorer 启动时按 CLSID 加载组件，写这里等于随桌面一起起。
why.en: explorer loads components here by CLSID, so this rides along with the desktop.

fix.zh: 确认 CLSID 属于已知组件，否则清空该值。
fix.en: Confirm the CLSID is a known component, otherwise clear the value.

why.zh: BHO 随浏览器加载，是广告件和窃取插件的常用位置。
why.en: BHOs load with the browser; common home for adware and stealers.

fix.zh: 核对 CLSID 对应的 DLL，非必要则删除。
fix.en: Check which DLL the CLSID resolves to; remove if not needed.

why.zh: netsh 启动时加载 helper DLL，位于系统目录之外就可疑。
why.en: netsh loads helper DLLs; one outside System32 is suspicious.

fix.zh: 核对 DLL 路径，删除非系统条目。
fix.en: Check the DLL path, remove non-system entries.

title.zh: LSA 通知包包含未知模块
title.en: LSA notification packages include an unknown module

why.zh: lsass 加载这些 DLL，权限最高，一旦被劫持等于交出了凭据。
why.en: lsass loads these at the highest privilege; hijacking one hands over credentials.

fix.zh: 只保留 scecli、rassfm、kdcsvc，其余移除后重启。
fix.en: Keep only scecli, rassfm, kdcsvc; remove the rest and reboot.

title.zh: 最短密码长度不足 8 位

why.zh: 短密码让在线爆破的尝试次数降到可接受范围。
why.en: Short passwords pull online brute force back into a feasible number of tries.

fix.zh: MinimumPasswordLength 设为 8 或更高。
fix.en: Set MinimumPasswordLength to 8 or higher.

why.zh: 不锁定等于不限次数，爆破只看时间够不够。
why.en: No lockout means unlimited attempts; brute force is only a question of time.

fix.zh: LockoutBadCount 设为 5。
fix.en: Set LockoutBadCount to 5.

why.zh: 锁定几分钟就自动解开，等于给对手一个免费节流阀。
why.en: A few minutes of lockout hands the attacker a free rate limiter.

fix.zh: LockoutDuration 设为 15 分钟以上。
fix.en: Set LockoutDuration to 15 minutes or more.

why.zh: 历史为 0 时改密码可以原地绕回，改密形同虚设。
why.en: With no history a reset goes straight back to the old value, so a reset does nothing.

fix.zh: PasswordHistorySize 设为 5 以上。
fix.en: Set PasswordHistorySize to 5 or more.

why.zh: 长期不换的凭据一旦泄露，有效期就是无限。
why.en: A credential that never rotates stays valid forever once it leaks.

fix.zh: MaxPasswordAge 设为 90 天以内。
fix.en: Set MaxPasswordAge to 90 days or less.

why.zh: 没有字符类别要求，弱密码比例的下降全靠运气。
why.en: Without a category requirement, weak passwords drop only by luck.

fix.zh: PasswordComplexity 设为 1。
fix.en: Set PasswordComplexity to 1.

title.zh: 锁定计数重置窗口过短

why.zh: 窗口短于锁定时长时，锁定期满后计数已清零，可以立刻再来一轮。
why.en: When the window is shorter than the lockout, the counter clears before release and the next round starts clean.

fix.zh: ResetLockoutCount 设为 15 分钟以上。
fix.en: Set ResetLockoutCount to 15 minutes or more.

why.zh: 空密码账户可以直接登录，无需任何凭据。
why.en: A blank password account logs in with no credential at all.

fix.zh: LimitBlankPasswordUse 设为 1。
fix.en: Set LimitBlankPasswordUse to 1.

title.zh: 远程注册表服务在运行

why.zh: 远程改注册表等于远程改系统行为，默认应禁用。
why.en: Remote registry edits change system behaviour from a distance; off by default for a reason.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 RemoteRegistry。
fix.en: Stop and disable RemoteRegistry.

why.zh: 明文协议，凭据在网络上直接可见。
why.en: A cleartext protocol; credentials are readable off the wire.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 TlntSvr。
fix.en: Stop and disable TlntSvr.

title.zh: 路由与远程访问服务在运行
title.en: Routing and remote access is running

why.zh: 这台机器成了网络入口，攻击面从本机扩展到整条路径。
why.en: The host becomes a network entry point, widening the surface beyond itself.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 RemoteAccess。
fix.en: Stop and disable RemoteAccess.

why.zh: 远程管理通道，凭据和命令都走 5985/5986。
why.en: A remote management channel; credentials and commands ride 5985/5986.

fix.zh: 确认确有需要，否则停止并禁用 WinRM。
fix.en: Keep it only if something needs it; otherwise stop and disable WinRM.

why.zh: 对外广播设备存在，是 UPnP 攻击的常见入口。
why.en: Advertises the device on the network; a common UPnP entry point.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 SSDPSRV。
fix.en: Stop and disable SSDPSRV.

why.zh: 打印相关漏洞多年反复，服务器上通常不需要打印。
why.en: Print-related flaws keep returning; a server rarely needs to print.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 Spooler。
fix.en: Stop and disable Spooler.

why.zh: SNMPv1/v2 的社区字符串多半是 public，等于公开读取设备信息。
why.en: SNMPv1/v2 community strings are usually public, which exposes device data.

fix.zh: 停止并禁用 SNMP。
fix.en: Stop and disable SNMP.

why.zh: Windows 上跑 SSH 属于额外加的入口，需要明确授权。
why.en: SSH on Windows is an added entry point and needs to be deliberate.

fix.zh: 确认是谁开的，不需要则停服务。
fix.en: Find out who opened it; stop the service if unneeded.

why.zh: 23 端口开放意味着有人用明文协议对外服务。
why.en: Port 23 open means a cleartext protocol is being served.

fix.zh: 停掉对应服务。
fix.en: Stop the service behind it.

why.zh: 明文文件传输，账号密码和内容都不加密。
why.en: Cleartext file transfer; both credentials and content travel unencrypted.

fix.zh: 改用 SFTP 或 SMB3 加密，停掉 FTP。
fix.en: Move to SFTP or encrypted SMB3 and stop FTP.

why.zh: 5985 走明文 HTTP，凭据只在传输层之外靠协商保护。
why.en: 5985 speaks plain HTTP; credentials are protected only by whatever was negotiated above it.

fix.zh: 只保留 5986，或关闭 WinRM。
fix.en: Keep only 5986, or turn WinRM off.

why.zh: 通用 Windows 主机上出现数据库端口，通常是被装上去的额外服务。
why.en: A database port on a general-purpose Windows host usually means something got installed on the side.

fix.zh: 确认用途，只绑内网或关闭。
fix.en: Confirm the purpose; bind to the LAN only or close it.

title.zh: 一天内登录失败次数异常
title.en: Failed logons spike within a day

why.zh: 4625 在 24 小时内超过 20 次，多半是有人在试密码。
why.en: Over 20 4625 events in 24 hours usually means someone is guessing passwords.

fix.zh: 看来源账户与 IP，必要时封禁并改密。
fix.en: Check the account and source, block it and rotate the password.

title.zh: 近七天有计划任务被创建
title.en: Scheduled task created in the last week

why.zh: 4698 是持久化最直接的证据，需要知道是谁建的。
why.en: 4698 is the most direct persistence evidence; you need to know who created it.

fix.zh: 核对任务内容与创建者。
fix.en: Review the task body and its creator.

title.zh: 近三十天有本地账户被创建
title.en: Local account created in the last month

why.zh: 4720 出现即说明有人在这台机器上加过身份。
why.en: A 4720 means an identity was added to this machine.

fix.zh: 确认创建者与用途，无主则删除。
fix.en: Confirm creator and purpose; delete if unowned.

title.zh: 事件日志服务未设为自动

why.zh: 日志服务被停或改手动，等于关掉了全部留痕。
why.en: Stopping it or switching it to manual switches off every record the box keeps.

fix.zh: Set-Service EventLog -StartupType Automatic 并启动。
fix.en: Set-Service EventLog -StartupType Automatic and start it.

title.zh: ProgramData 根目录有可执行文件
title.en: Executable at the root of ProgramData

why.zh: 很多系统上 ProgramData 可被普通用户写入，放 exe 是投递的常见落点。
why.en: ProgramData is writable by normal users on many builds, which makes it a common drop point.

fix.zh: 取哈希核实来源，确认后再处理。
fix.en: Hash it, verify origin, then decide.

title.en: DLL at the top of a user profile

why.zh: 放在这里的 DLL 会被相对路径解析加载，是劫持的现成目标。
why.en: A DLL here gets picked up by relative path resolution, which is a ready-made hijack target.

fix.zh: 核对来源，非必要则移走。
fix.en: Check where it came from; move it out if unneeded.

title.zh: 自动登录保存了明文密码

why.zh: DefaultPassword 是明文写进注册表的，读一次就拿到账号。
why.en: DefaultPassword sits in the registry in plaintext; one read hands over the account.

fix.zh: 删除 DefaultPassword 与 AutoAdminLogon，改用凭据管理器。
fix.en: Remove DefaultPassword and AutoAdminLogon; use Credential Manager instead.

title.en: RDP idle sessions never time out

why.zh: 没人操作的会话一直保持已认证状态，等于常开的门。
why.en: An unattended session stays authenticated, which is a door left open.

fix.zh: MaxIdleTime 设为 15 分钟。
fix.en: Set MaxIdleTime to 15 minutes.

why.zh: 这个组合键能证明输入来自真实键盘，防止登录界面被伪造。
why.en: The key combination proves input came from a real keyboard, which defeats a faked logon screen.

fix.zh: DisableCAD 设为 0。
fix.en: Set DisableCAD to 0.

title.zh: 登录界面显示上次用户名
title.en: Logon screen shows the last username

why.zh: 省掉猜账号这一步，爆破直接从密码开始。
why.en: It removes the account guess and lets brute force start at the password.

fix.zh: DontDisplayLastUserName 设为 1。
fix.en: Set DontDisplayLastUserName to 1.

title.en: Pagefile is not cleared at shutdown

why.zh: 内存里的东西会留在磁盘上，冷启动攻击或拆盘都能读。
why.en: Memory contents stay on disk, readable by a cold-boot attack or by pulling the drive.

fix.zh: ClearPageFileAtShutdown 设为 1。
fix.en: Set ClearPageFileAtShutdown to 1.
